description: Defines the LeaveRequestComment entity class for ORM, representing comments on leave requests in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LeaveRequestComment
classes.description: Entity class representing comments associated with leave requests, including metadata such as creator and timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the comment.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the comment.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Associates a LeaveRequest object with this comment.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the User who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the User who created the comment.

methods.name: getCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who created the comment.

methods.name: setCreatedByEmployee
methods.description: Sets the Employee who created the comment.
